outcome.technical: One reading of executor.phaseGateOnly, in _config_rules.py: phase_gate_only_match, left_to_phase_gate (moved from audit-lookup.py, which now aliases it), and phase_gate_only_split(steps, phase_steps, names), which returns kept, left and unheld. A step counts as held when the phase gate has the same entry name or the same resolved command. _evidence_io.py: phase_gate_steps(manifest, phase) gives the phase's runnable gate, resolved and without review-only entries. New row key leftToPhaseGate (LEFT_TO_PHASE_GATE_KEY): each entry has the fields name, arm, basis and matched; row_for copies it only when the run left something out. Also left_to_phase_gate_record and left_to_phase_gate_names (declared arm only). run-test-gate.py: under --task, and not --own, after the affected steps join and after the declared part is cut for gateDigest, phase_gate_only_plan leaves out the named steps the phase gate holds, whichever arm proposed them (decision 3). Each left-out or unheld step prints a line (stderr under --json); reach_args, the reuse identity and the measured run are taken over the steps that ran; res carries leftToPhaseGate on measured, part-reused and reused results. When every step is left out, _all_left records all_left_result: status no-checks, ranTotal 0, with the reason in each basis; it prints NO CHECK RAN and exits 1. An unusable key is refused with E_ASK. The phase-scope run never asks. _verdict_binding.gate_mismatch compares the recorded declared steps with the declaration minus the names the row lists. A listed name the gate does not declare, or a listed name the row also ran, still fails the length/prefix comparison, so an extra guard I first wrote was dropped as unreachable: a mutation probe showed vb39 stayed green without it. drive-phase.py: task_gate_steps(manifest, phase, task_id, left=()) drops the same steps through the split; already_wide is still asked of the declared entries; chosen_task_gate reads the setting from ctx['config'] (a malformed key leaves nothing out there; the runner refuses it by name). The split is asked only when names are set, because one np-block fixture replaces _evio with a namespace. audit-lookup.compose_writer_prompt uses the same split against _evio.phase_gate_steps: a named command the phase gate does not hold stays listed with UNHELD_NOTE. The _wp_manifest fixture now gives the phase a testGate equal to the task's gate, so the existing wp/ws cases still leave the browser checks out; a task declaring no gate gets no phase gate either. Panel: help sentence and label only. Docs updated: schema description, plugin README config row, COMPATIBILITY.md (config-key Promised section: a set value now does more, absence unchanged), CHANGELOG (Unreleased, Changed), PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE (run-test-gate, drive gate choice, _verdict_binding and _config_rules sections; the module-map fence regenerated by `_deps.py --write-map`, whose only change is the new run-test-gate -> _config_rules edge). Root README.md does not name the key, so it was not touched. Gate command (brief's, from the tree) exit 0: 4/4 files ok, 2047 cases. Related sweep over test__evidence_io, test__verdict_binding, test__panel_settings, test__panel_page, test__config_rules_lints, test_validate_config, test__config, test__deps, test__help, test__impact, test_panel_server, test_audit_task, test_close_phase, test_commit_task_work, test__output_lints, test_meter_usage, test__panel_paths and test_drive_without_model: 17/18 files ok; test__deps g1 failed on the stale module map, which was then regenerated, and test__deps, test__evidence_io and test__output_lints then ran 3/3 ok, 813 cases. ruff and vermin -t=3.8- were clean on the changed files. Mutation probes, in process or on in-memory copies of module source, with no tree writes: split never leaves -> pgo1-5, pgo8, pg5, pg6, wa1, wa2, gc11, gc12 red; split leaves every named step (over-fire) -> pgo4, pg5, wa2, gc11 red; binding blind to the key -> vb38, vb39 red; binding excuses any listed row, or binds a short prefix when anything is listed -> vb39 red; reader keeps every arm -> ltp2 red; baseline none red. Known non-red: binding reading every arm is caught by the length comparison, so vb39 cannot see it; ltp2 holds that filter directly. Dependants: the writer brief's reading now comes from _config_rules (the same function); the drive's view agrees with the recorder (gc11, gc12); the affected selection's already-wide test is still asked of the full declared entries, in both the runner and the drive; the reuse identity is taken over the steps that ran (pgo2); the panel help and label are changed; the doctor reads the key through the schema description, which is changed; commit-task-work and audit-task done bind through _verdict_binding, which reads the new key (a real pgo1 row gives gate_mismatch None, probed); verify-invariants is unchanged. Left alone: the writer prompt still leaves a step to the drive's gate because its recorded mean is slow, which the recorder runs. That is a different reason with the same sentence, and it existed before this task.
outcome.descriptive: executor.phaseGateOnly now also leaves a named command out of a task's recorded gate when the phase gate runs it, lists it on the row, and the writer brief, recorder, drive and verdict binding all read it one way.
